title: Real-time Chat
description: Build a real-time chat simulation using an event-driven architecture. You'll create a message event emitter, manage chat state, render a chat UI, and add username and timestamp support.

steps.title: Message event emitter
steps.description: Create an `EventEmitter` class with `on` and `emit` methods. The `on` method registers a listener for an event name, and `emit` calls all registered listeners with the given data.
hints: Store listeners as an object where keys are event names and values are arrays of callback functions
The `on` method should push the callback to the array for the given event name
The `emit` method should loop through the callbacks and invoke each one with the data argument

verification.test: output.includes('Received: Hello!') && output.includes('Received: How are you?')
verification.successMessage: Event emitter works! Messages are being received through events.
verification.failureMessage: Make sure on() registers listeners and emit() calls them with the correct data.

steps.title: Add message
steps.description: Create an `addMessage` function that stores messages in an array and emits a `'message'` event. Each message should be an object with `{ text, id }`.
hints: Store messages in an array with a unique id (use a counter or Date.now())

verification.successMessage: Messages are being stored and emitted correctly!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure addMessage adds to the messages array and the event listener logs each message.

steps.title: Render chat UI
steps.description: Create a `renderChat` function that builds a string representation of the chat. Each message should be formatted as `"[id] text"` on its own line.
hints: Use .map() to transform each message into a formatted string
Join the array with newline characters: .join('\n')

verification.test: output.includes('[1] Hello!') && output.includes('[2] How are you?')
verification.successMessage: Chat UI renders messages in the correct format!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure each message is formatted as [id] text on its own line.

steps.title: Username
steps.description: Extend messages to include a `username` field. Update `addMessage` to accept a username parameter, and update `renderChat` to show `"username: text"`.
hints: Add username to the message object alongside id and text
Update addMessage to accept (text, username) parameters
Update renderChat format to `[id] username: text`

verification.successMessage: Usernames are attached to messages correctly!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure addMessage stores the username and renderChat shows it.

steps.title: Timestamps
steps.description: Add a `timestamp` field to messages. Update `addMessage` to record the current time, and update `renderChat` to show `"[HH:MM] username: text"` format.
hints: Use new Date() to get the current time when creating a message
Format the time as HH:MM using toLocaleTimeString or manual formatting
Update the render format to include the timestamp before the username

verification.successMessage: Your real-time chat is complete! Messages show sender, timestamp, and content.
verification.failureMessage: Make sure renderChat includes timestamps in HH:MM format before each username.
